name: University of East Anglia
description:
East Anglia University (UEA) is a public research university in Norwich, England. Established in 1963 on a 320-acre campus west of the city centre, the university has four faculties and 26 schools of study.

UEA is a research-intensive institution recognized for the quality of its research. It is ranked 10th in the UK for the quality of its research output (Times Higher REF 2014 Analysis). It is proud of its strong research into real-world issues such as cancer, dementia and climate change for water security and politics.

The campus and its grounds are open to the public and the site is visited by thousands every year who enjoy the beauty of the parkland, the forest and the Lake Broad.

More than 3,500 international students from over 100 countries globally enroll on courses every year.

What is the acceptance rate of the University of East Anglia?

The University of East Anglia acceptance rate is 81%.

The library is a grade II listed building, with a wealth of resources covering all disciplines. The library is open 24/7 for current staff and students, while visitors can access library resources between 7-7pm. Approximately 800,000 books, 550,000 e-books, and 97,500 online and print journals are housed within the library walls. The university invests heavily into providing world-class facilities. UEA boasts a huge Sportspark complex that includes a gym, swimming pool, indoor and outdoor sports courts, athletic tracks, and fitness studios. The Sainsbury Centre for Visual Arts is a museum and art gallery located on campus with a huge collection of artworks from different time periods. Exhibitions and performances are hosted here.

Student Life

Student clubs are a crucial part of student life as this is where youâ€™ll make friends and find like-minded people. Over 250 sports clubs and societies are set up on campus every year, plus there are more than 15 places to eat and 50 acres of parkland to provide an aesthetic backdrop to a studentâ€™s journey. The student union bar hosts sports screenings, club nights and regular events to bring everyone on campus together.

highlights.title: Overview
highlights.value: The University of East Anglia (UEA) is a public research university in Norwich, England. Established in 1963 on a 320-acre campus, the university has four faculties and 26 schools of study. It is ranked 10th in the UK for the quality of its research output (Times Higher REF 2014 Analysis). You’ll find that the university takes pride in its strong research efforts, particularly in tackling real-world issues like cancer, dementia, and climate change, with a focus on water security and politics.

highlights.title: Student Life
highlights.value: At UEA, you'll be part of a diverse campus community, with over 3,500 students from around the world. Whether you're looking to make new friends or attend fun cultural events, the university provides so many opportunities to enhance your student experience. With over 200 student-led clubs, societies, and peer support groups, you’ll have everything you need to make the most of your time at university and enhance your studies.

highlights.title: Accommodation
highlights.value:
The housing at UEA is award-winning, with more than 4,300 rooms on the UEA campus. You’ll have a range of accommodation options to choose from, including residence halls and homestays within different living communities. The University’s housing services team can assist you with finding living spaces to suit your needs and preferences.

If you’re looking for budget-friendly accommodation options outside the campus, feel free to download our app and check out the Stays feature!

highlights.title: Facilities
highlights.value:
Library
The University of East Anglia (UEA) offers you access to a 24/7 library. It features various study spaces, including individual booths, group study areas, and silent study rooms. You’ll find extensive digital resources and specialist collections to help with your research. Approximately 800,000 books, 550,000 e-books, and 97,500 online and print journals are available at the library.

Sports
UEA boasts a massive Sportspark complex, giving you access to a gym, swimming pool, indoor and outdoor sports courts, athletic tracks, and fitness studios. Whether you're looking to stay active, train for a competition, or simply enjoy some leisure time, you'll find plenty of options to keep yourself fit.

Laboratory
The university features state-of-the-art laboratories across various disciplines, particularly in health sciences and engineering. These labs are equipped with advanced technology to support your hands-on learning and research.

Cafeteria
There are many dining options at UEA, including several cafes and eateries. You can grab a quick meal or snack at Blend, or relax with a bite at the Atrium Cafe and Vista Cafe, two of the most popular spots on campus.
